hooks.name: Type Check and Lint on TypeScript Save

action.prompt:
A TypeScript source file was just saved in the MoneyPrinter project (not a test file). Run these checks and report findings:

1. **TypeScript type check** (whole project):
   Run: `cd /Users/manishkumar/Desktop/money-printer && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40`
   → Report every type error with file, line, and message. If clean, say "✓ No type errors".

2. **ESLint** (src directory):
   Run: `cd /Users/manishkumar/Desktop/money-printer && npx eslint 'src/**/*.ts' --max-warnings 0 2>&1 | tail -20`
   → Report every lint violation. If clean, say "✓ No lint issues".

3. **Server health** (quick ping):
   Run: `curl -s --max-time 2 http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null && echo 'server-up' || echo 'server-not-running'`

Format output as:
```
📁 TypeScript file saved
✓/❌ TypeScript: clean / N errors
  [list errors if any]
✓/❌ ESLint: clean / N violations
  [list violations if any]
✓/⚠ Server: healthy / not running
```

Only report findings — do not auto-fix unless the user asks.
